issues.desc: background.md ## Trigger Event references "B-914f's cross-host serialization assumption" without any explanation of what B-914f is or what assumption it established. A fresh reader with no conversation history and no access to other story directories cannot resolve this cross-story reference from the text alone (still unaddressed by the citation-fix edit).

background.md ## Trigger Event cites opaque IDs "Intake probe rp-mrqfk0cx-bvnp86" and "repro review rr-mrqfkaj9-hj45oz" and the classification label "target-bug" without defining what an intake probe / repro review is or how a reader could look them up. IDs verified to exist under .lattice/evidence/refs/by-id/, so not fabricated, but no standalone context is given for a first-time reader.
